rationale: The response sustains the county-fair carnival-game register throughout without slipping into plain explanatory English. It rides the metaphor past where it works, including the 'Digital Teddy Bear Shooting Gallery' and 'Crypto Twitter' sections.
quote: The house always wins. The carnies always eat. And every year a fresh crop of wide-eyed kids shows up at the fair with their allowance money, convinced they've figured out how to beat the game that ate their older brother's life savings.
